{"id":"2026-eurasc-fellow","year":2026,"date":"","category":"award","title_en":"Prof. Yongqiang Zhang elected as a Non-European Fellow of EurASc","title_zh":"热烈祝贺张永强研究员当选欧洲科学院外籍院士","summary_en":"Elected to the Earth and Environmental Sciences division of the European Academy of Sciences for contributions to evapotranspiration modelling and global water cycle research.","summary_zh":"张永强研究员当选欧洲科学院外籍院士，被纳入地球与环境科学学部，表彰其在蒸散发模拟与全球水循环研究领域的系统性、创新性贡献。","body_md":"近日，**中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所张永强研究员**正式当选为**欧洲科学院（European Academy of Sciences，简称EurASc）外籍院士**（Non-European Fellow/Member），被纳入**地球与环境科学学部**。这一殊荣是国际学术界对其在*蒸散发模拟与全球水循环研究*领域作出系统性、创新性贡献的高度肯定。

## 关于欧洲科学院

欧洲科学院成立于2003年，总部位于比利时布鲁塞尔，是欧洲具有重要影响力的国际学术组织之一。学院致力于推动科学与技术创新，促进跨学科合作，现有活跃院士800余位，遍布全球55个国家，其中非欧洲国家占比小于25%，涵盖自然科学、工程技术、生命科学及社会科学等九大领域。院士遴选严格遵循学术成就与国际影响力标准，代表了欧洲及全球顶尖学术水准。

## 学术成就与贡献

张永强研究员长期致力于陆地水循环与生态水文研究。他在蒸散发机理解析、全球水资源变化及气候变化影响评估等方面取得了一系列具有国际影响力的创新成果。其中，他提出并发展的 PML 三层蒸散发模型，成功实现了植被蒸腾与生态生产力的耦合模拟，已成为全球蒸散发估算领域的标杆性成果，被广泛应用于科研与业务领域。

张永强研究员以第一和通讯作者身份在*Science*、*Nature Geoscience*、*Nature Water*等国际顶尖期刊发表多篇论文。其谷歌学术总引用次数超 2.4 万次，H 指数达 75，并连续五年入选地理学"中国高被引学者"榜单。

## 学院贺信

欧洲科学院在官方贺信中表示，张永强研究员的学术成就获得了学院理事会的高度认可，并期待他未来积极参与欧洲科学院的学术活动与国际合作，共同为全球科学事业贡献力量。","source_url":"https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/_8T-fGZJGqaO5_dXoS0qwA","cover_id":"47431d51b2f6a282","featured":1,"sort_order":10,"status":"published","created_at":"2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z","updated_at":"2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z","archived_at":null}

{"id":"2026-nature-geoscience-water-cycle","year":2026,"date":"2026-01-09","category":"publication","title_en":"Nature Geoscience: quantifying the global water cycle more precisely and updating the classic diagram","title_zh":"课题组在Nature Geoscience发文：更精准量化全球水循环分量，更新传统水循环示意图","summary_en":"Constraining Earth system models with river flow from 50 large basins puts global river flow at 39.1 ± 5.4 × 10³ km³ per year, lower than most earlier estimates.","summary_zh":"结合全球 50 条大型河流的实测径流约束地球系统模型，将全球河川流量修正为 39.1 ± 5.4 × 10³ km³/yr，低于以往多数估计。","body_md":"水是地球表层系统的核心要素，是链接各圈层的关键纽带。然而，全球水循环的量化尤其是河川流量与蒸散发的准确划分，长期受限于模型误差与观测不足，导致对未来水资源变化的预测存在高度不确定性。为破解这一难题，中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所张永强研究员联合国内、国际团队，创新性地融合大流域河川径流观测数据与地球系统模型，系统重构了全球水循环各分量的分配比例与未来趋势。

## 研究内容

研究采用“涌现约束”方法，结合全球50条大型河流1980–2014年的实测径流数据，对多个地球系统模型进行校正。结果显示，该时期全球陆地河川流量为 39.1± 5.4×103km3yr-1，径流系数为0.35±0.03，显著低于以往多数研究的估计（图1）；陆地蒸散发量为73.4±6.2×103km3yr-1。这表明此前许多模型系统性高估了全球河川流量。研究进一步将河川流量划分为地表流与地下基流，发现约66%的河源来自地下水贡献；在蒸散发中，作物蒸腾占比约12.3%，量化了农业用水对全球水循环的影响（图2）。尤为重要的是，该研究基于最新数据绘制了全球水循环示意图，不仅涵盖降水、蒸散发、径流等传统组分，更明确了地下水流、人类用水、植被蒸腾等关键过程的占比，对教科书中长期使用的水循环示意图进行了重要的更新与补充。

在未来气候变化情景下，经观测数据校正的预测表明，全球每升温1°C，河川流量将增加7.8±5.5mm yr-1，较未经校正的模型平均值低9.3%，不确定性降低约66%（图3）。这表明当前气候模型可能高估了未来河川流量的增长幅度，尤其是在加入灌溉、水库调节等人为影响后，实际可用水资源的增长可能更为有限。

## 发表信息

该成果于2026年1月9日在线发表于《自然·地球科学》（Nature Geoscience）。中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所张永强研究员为论文第一作者和唯一通讯作者。合作团队包括奥地利维也纳科技大学、澳大利亚联邦科工组织、美国太平洋西北国家实验室、德国波茨坦大学、武汉大学、中国地质大学（武汉）等机构的多名学者。

研究获国家自然科学基金（42330506、42361144709）、科技部领军人才计划、中国科学院国际团队项目等支持。

after: {"value":{"person_id":"yongqiang-zhang","title_en":"Distinguished Professor, Hydrology and Water Resources","title_zh":"二级研究员，水文与水资源","bio_en":["Dr. Yongqiang Zhang is a Distinguished Professor in Hydrology and Water Resources at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences. He is a Non-European Fellow of the European Academy of Sciences (elected 2026) and also serves as the Deputy Director of the Key Laboratory of Land Water Cycle and Surface Processes. Professor Zhang is a Fellow of the Modelling and Simulation Society of Australia and New Zealand and a Fellow of the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation in Germany. He currently holds leadership roles as the Director of the Hydro-Geography Committee of the Geographical Society of China and chairs the Hydrometeorology Stream of the Modelling and Simulation Society of Australia and New Zealand. In addition, Professor Zhang serves on the editorial boards of five major international journals, including Journal of Geophysical Research: Atmospheres, Journal of Hydrology, and Remote Sensing of Environment. Over the past five years, he has led seven key research projects, including grants from the National Key Research and Development Program, a key project of the National Natural Science Foundation, and the Talent Program of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.","Professor Zhang has devoted his career to large scale hydrology, with a special focus on evapotranspiration mechanisms and their eco-hydrological effects. He has published 260 papers in peer-reviewed journals, including prestigious titles such as Science, Nature Water, and Nature Communications. In the past five years alone, he has authored or co-authored 70 papers as first or corresponding author in top-tier journals. His research has been cited more than 24,000 times, and he has an H-index of 75. His most cited first-authored paper has accumulated over 700 citations. In addition, Professor Zhang has ten ESI Highly Cited Papers and has been recognized as an Elsevier Highly Cited Chinese Researcher for five consecutive years.","The team led by Professor Zhang comprises professors, associate professors, postdoc fellows, doctoral candidates, and master's students, totaling about 30 members. Students in the team are primarily recruited from leading universities such as Tsinghua University, Beijing Normal University, Northwest A&F University, and Hohai University. The team actively collaborates with top researchers both in China and abroad and has established long-term academic partnerships with internationally renowned institutions, including Ghent University, Vienna University of Technology, Pacific Northwest National Laboratory in the United States, and the Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO) in Australia.","Under Professor Zhang's supervision, students and young researchers from both China and abroad have thrived in a dynamic, interdisciplinary research environment. Domestically, team members regularly present at major national conferences and have received numerous awards for young scientists. International students and visiting scholars contribute diverse perspectives, with many going on to secure positions at leading global institutions. This cultivation of next-generation talent underscores the team's lasting impact on the hydrological sciences worldwide."],"bio_zh":["张永强博士是中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所水文与水资源学科的二级研究员，欧洲科学院外籍院士（2026 年当选），同时担任陆地水循环及地表过程重点实验室副主任。张教授是澳大利亚和新西兰模型模拟学会会士，德国洪堡基金会学者。他目前担任中国地理学会水文地理专业委员会主任，以及澳大利亚和新西兰模型模拟学会水文气象部主席。此外，张教授还担任五个主要国际期刊的编委，包括Journal of Geophysical Research: Atmospheres、Journal of Hydrology和Remote Sensing of Environment。在过去五年中，他主持了七个重点科研项目，包括国家重点研发计划、国家自然科学基金重点项目和中国科学院人才计划等。","张教授致力于大尺度水文学研究，特别关注蒸散发机制及其生态水文效应。他在同行评审期刊上发表了260篇论文，包括Science、Nature Water和Nature Communications等著名期刊。仅在过去五年，他就以第一作者或通讯作者身份在顶级期刊发表了70篇论文。他的研究已被引用超过24,000次，H指数为75。他的被引次数最多的第一作者论文累计引用超过700次。此外，张教授拥有10篇ESI高被引论文，并连续五年被评为爱思唯尔中国高被引学者。","张教授领导的团队由教授、副教授、博士后、博士研究生和硕士研究生组成，共有约30名成员。团队学生主要来自清华大学、北京师范大学、西北农林科技大学和河海大学等国内一流大学。团队积极与国内外顶尖研究人员合作，并与国际知名机构建立了长期学术合作关系，包括根特大学、维也纳工业大学、美国西北太平洋国家实验室和澳大利亚联邦科学与工业研究组织（CSIRO）。","在张教授的指导下，来自中国和国外的学生和青年研究人员在一个充满活力的跨学科研究环境中茁壮成长。在国内，团队成员定期在主要的全国性会议上发表演讲，并获得了众多青年科学家奖项。国际学生和访问学者贡献了多元化的视角，许多人随后在全球领先机构获得了职位。这种对下一代人才的培养凸显了该团队对全球水文科学的持久影响。"]}}

before: {"value":{"person_id":"yongqiang-zhang","title_en":"Distinguished Professor, Hydrology and Water Resources","title_zh":"二级研究员，水文与水资源","bio_en":["Dr. Yongqiang Zhang is a Distinguished Professor in Hydrology and Water Resources at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences. He is a Non-European Fellow of the European Academy of Sciences (elected 2026) and also serves as the Deputy Director of the Key Laboratory of Land Water Cycle and Surface Processes. Professor Zhang is a Fellow of the Modelling and Simulation Society of Australia and New Zealand and a Fellow of the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation in Germany. He currently holds leadership roles as the Director of the Hydro-Geography Committee of the Geographical Society of China and chairs the Hydrometeorology Stream of the Modelling and Simulation Society of Australia and New Zealand. In addition, Professor Zhang serves on the editorial boards of five major international journals, including Journal of Geophysical Research: Atmospheres, Journal of Hydrology, and Remote Sensing of Environment. Over the past five years, he has led seven key research projects, including grants from the National Key Research and Development Program, a key project of the National Natural Science Foundation, and the Talent Program of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.","Professor Zhang has devoted his career to large scale hydrology, with a special focus on evapotranspiration mechanisms and their eco-hydrological effects. He has published 260 papers in peer-reviewed journals, including prestigious titles such as Science, Nature Water, and Nature Communications. In the past five years alone, he has authored or co-authored 70 papers as first or corresponding author in top-tier journals. His research has been cited more than 24,000 times, and he has an H-index of 75. His most cited first-authored paper has accumulated over 700 citations. In addition, Professor Zhang has ten ESI Highly Cited Papers and has been recognized as an Elsevier Highly Cited Chinese Researcher for five consecutive years.","The team led by Professor Zhang comprises professors, associate professors, postdoc fellows, doctoral candidates, and master's students, totaling about 30 members. Students in the team are primarily recruited from leading universities such as Tsinghua University, Beijing Normal University, Northwest A&F University, and Hohai University. The team actively collaborates with top researchers both in China and abroad and has established long-term academic partnerships with internationally renowned institutions, including Ghent University, Vienna University of Technology, Pacific Northwest National Laboratory in the United States, and the Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO) in Australia.","Under Professor Zhang's supervision, students and young researchers from both China and abroad have thrived in a dynamic, interdisciplinary research environment. Domestically, team members regularly present at major national conferences and have received numerous awards for young scientists. International students and visiting scholars contribute diverse perspectives, with many going on to secure positions at leading global institutions. This cultivation of next-generation talent underscores the team's lasting impact on the hydrological sciences worldwide."],"bio_zh":["张永强博士是中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所水文与水资源学科的二级研究员，欧洲科学院外籍院士（2026 年当选），同时担任陆地水循环及地表过程重点实验室副主任。张教授是澳大利亚和新西兰模型模拟学会会士，德国洪堡基金会学者。他目前担任中国地理学会水文地理专业委员会主任，以及澳大利亚和新西兰模型模拟学会水文气象部主席。此外，张教授还担任五个主要国际期刊的编委，包括Journal of Geophysical Research: Atmospheres、Journal of Hydrology和Remote Sensing of Environment。在过去五年中，他主持了七个重点科研项目，包括国家重点研发计划、国家自然科学基金重点项目和中国科学院人才计划等。","张教授致力于大尺度水文学研究，特别关注蒸散发机制及其生态水文效应。他在同行评审期刊上发表了260篇论文，包括Science、Nature Water和Nature Communications等著名期刊。仅在过去五年，他就以第一作者或通讯作者身份在顶级期刊发表了70篇论文。他的研究已被引用超过24,000次，H指数为75。他的被引次数最多的第一作者论文累计引用超过700次。此外，张教授拥有10篇ESI高被引论文，并连续五年被评为爱思唯尔中国高被引学者。","张教授领导的团队由教授、副教授、博士后、博士研究生和硕士研究生组成，共有约30名成员。团队学生主要来自清华大学、北京师范大学、西北农林科技大学和河海大学等国内一流大学。团队积极与国内外顶尖研究人员合作，并与国际知名机构建立了长期学术合作关系，包括根特大学、维也纳工业大学、美国西北太平洋国家实验室和澳大利亚联邦科学与工业研究组织（CSIRO）。","在张教授的指导下，来自中国和国外的学生和青年研究人员在一个充满活力的跨学科研究环境中茁壮成长。在国内，团队成员定期在主要的全国性会议上发表演讲，并获得了众多青年科学家奖项。国际学生和访问学者贡献了多元化的视角，许多人随后在全球领先机构获得了职位。这种对下一代人才的培养凸显了该团队对全球水文科学的持久影响。"]}}

{"id":"2026-science-advances-et-asymmetry","year":2026,"date":"2026-08-27","category":"publication","title_en":"Science Advances: hemispheric asymmetry reveals a redistribution of terrestrial water fluxes","title_zh":"Science Advances：揭示全球陆地蒸散发的半球不对称性与水通量重分配","summary_en":"Observations from 183 large basins reveal opposing evapotranspiration trends in the Northern and Southern Hemispheres during 2000–2022.","summary_zh":"结合全球 183 个大型流域的水文观测，揭示 2000—2022 年北半球蒸散发增加、南半球蒸散发下降的相反趋势。","body_md":"中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所张永强研究员团队联合国内外学者，在 **Science Advances** 发表研究论文，揭示全球陆地蒸散发变化的半球不对称性。张永强为论文第一作者和通讯作者。

## 相反的半球趋势

研究整合全球 183 个大型流域的降水、径流和 GRACE 陆地水储量观测，结合五种诊断性蒸散发产品与机器学习算法，重建 2000—2022 年陆地蒸散发变化。全球整体变化趋势较弱，但北半球显著增加、南半球显著下降，二者相互抵消。

北半球蒸散发增加主要与植被变绿有关；南半球的下降主要受降水亏缺和大气干旱影响，亚马逊流域对南半球蒸散发下降的贡献超过 40%。这一结果提示，评估全球水循环变化时需要关注区域差异及水分供给的约束。

## 团队合作

李聪聪、许振武、田静、张选泽、马宁、李晓婕、魏豪杉等团队成员参与研究，并与孔冬冬及多位国内外学者合作完成。

## 论文信息

{"id":"2026-nsr-drought-recovery","year":2026,"date":"2026-10-13","category":"publication","title_en":"National Science Review: unequal basin-scale recovery after severe droughts","title_zh":"National Science Review：揭示干旱后全球大流域水储量恢复的不均衡性","summary_en":"Satellite observations of 468 severe drought events show that recovery depends on water availability, recurring drought and human water use.","summary_zh":"基于 468 次严重干旱事件，揭示旱后水分可利用性、干旱反复发生与人类用水压力对水储量恢复的影响。","body_md":"团队在 **National Science Review** 发表论文，利用 GRACE/FO 卫星观测与多源水文气象资料，分析全球大流域严重干旱后的水储量恢复。许振武博士后为第一作者，张永强研究员为通讯作者。论文于 **2026 年 9 月 30 日** 在线发表。

## 全球大流域的旱后恢复

研究以 174 个面积超过 10 万平方公里的大型流域为对象，分析 2003—2025 年间 468 次严重干旱事件。自水储量亏缺达到最大值起，5 年内累积恢复概率为 84 ± 2%，10 年内增至 89 ± 2%。多数已恢复事件的流域恢复时间中位数不超过 3 年，但干旱区和部分内流流域更容易出现长期亏缺。

## 从气象干旱结束到水储量补足

研究发现，旱后降水扣除蒸散发后的水分可利用性是恢复的关键。反复干旱与人类用水压力会延长亏缺状态，持续性损失多由地下水等剩余储水组分主导。干旱风险管理需要持续关注水储量是否真正恢复。

团队与 Günter Blöschl、Thorsten Wagener、Amir AghaKouchak、夏军、刘昌明等国内外学者合作完成该研究。

{"id":"2026-advanced-science-canglong-sst","year":2026,"date":"2026-10-18","category":"publication","title_en":"Advanced Science: CAS-Canglong improves sub-seasonal to seasonal sea surface temperature prediction","title_zh":"Advanced Science：中科苍龙提升全球海温次季节—季节预报能力","summary_en":"The 3D Swin Transformer predicts global sea surface temperature at 0.25° resolution, with forecast lead times up to 16 months.","summary_zh":"基于三维 Swin Transformer，在 0.25° 分辨率下开展全球海温预报，最长预报提前期可达 16 个月。","body_md":"张永强研究员团队研发面向全球海温次季节至季节（S2S）预报的 **中科苍龙（CAS-Canglong）** 大模型，相关成果发表于 **Advanced Science**。王龙浩、张选泽为共同第一作者，张永强为通讯作者。

## 融合海气信息的预报模型

模型采用三维 Swin Transformer，融合海温、气压、风场等八类海气变量，通过自注意力机制学习跨尺度时空联系。模型空间分辨率为 0.25° × 0.25°，最长可预报 16 个月。

## 与数值模式的比较

研究在独立测试资料上，将中科苍龙与 22 个主流数值模式进行比较。在 Niño 3.4 区、北极高纬海区、印太暖池及南大西洋、南印度洋、南太平洋等重点海区，模型在 1—3 个月提前期的海温异常均方根误差较数值多模式集合平均降低约 55.6%—63.4%。

研究为 ENSO 和全球海温演变预测提供了新方法，并为进一步开展水文气象风险预报奠定基础。

{"id":"2026-eurasc-fellow","year":2026,"date":"","category":"award","title_en":"Prof. Yongqiang Zhang elected as a Non-European Fellow of EurASc","title_zh":"热烈祝贺张永强研究员当选欧洲科学院外籍院士","summary_en":"Elected to the Earth and Environmental Sciences division of the European Academy of Sciences for contributions to evapotranspiration modelling and global water cycle research.","summary_zh":"张永强研究员当选欧洲科学院外籍院士，被纳入地球与环境科学学部，表彰其在蒸散发模拟与全球水循环研究领域的系统性、创新性贡献。","body_md":"近日，**中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所张永强研究员**正式当选为**欧洲科学院（European Academy of Sciences，简称EurASc）外籍院士**（Non-European Fellow/Member），被纳入**地球与环境科学学部**。这一殊荣是国际学术界对其在*蒸散发模拟与全球水循环研究*领域作出系统性、创新性贡献的高度肯定。

## 关于欧洲科学院

欧洲科学院成立于2003年，总部位于比利时布鲁塞尔，是欧洲具有重要影响力的国际学术组织之一。学院致力于推动科学与技术创新，促进跨学科合作，现有活跃院士800余位，遍布全球55个国家，其中非欧洲国家占比小于25%，涵盖自然科学、工程技术、生命科学及社会科学等九大领域。院士遴选严格遵循学术成就与国际影响力标准，代表了欧洲及全球顶尖学术水准。

## 学术成就与贡献

张永强研究员长期致力于陆地水循环与生态水文研究。他在蒸散发机理解析、全球水资源变化及气候变化影响评估等方面取得了一系列具有国际影响力的创新成果。其中，他提出并发展的 PML 三层蒸散发模型，成功实现了植被蒸腾与生态生产力的耦合模拟，已成为全球蒸散发估算领域的标杆性成果，被广泛应用于科研与业务领域。

张永强研究员以第一和通讯作者身份在*Science*、*Nature Geoscience*、*Nature Water*等国际顶尖期刊发表多篇论文。其谷歌学术总引用次数超 2.4 万次，H 指数达 75，并连续五年入选地理学"中国高被引学者"榜单。

## 学院贺信

欧洲科学院在官方贺信中表示，张永强研究员的学术成就获得了学院理事会的高度认可，并期待他未来积极参与欧洲科学院的学术活动与国际合作，共同为全球科学事业贡献力量。","source_url":"https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/_8T-fGZJGqaO5_dXoS0qwA","cover_id":"47431d51b2f6a282","featured":1,"sort_order":10,"status":"published","created_at":"2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z","updated_at":"2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z","archived_at":null}

## 研究方向

王龙浩为中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所自然地理学博士研究生，导师为张永强研究员。他关注深度学习与物理过程的结合，研究方向包括次季节—季节（S2S）预报、GRACE 陆地水储量、蒸散发及物理约束人工智能。

## 相关研究

王龙浩与张选泽共同作为第一作者，在 Advanced Science 发表中科苍龙全球海温预报研究，探索利用三维 Transformer 提升海温及 ENSO 预报能力。

before: {"value":{"person_id":"yongqiang-zhang","title_en":"Distinguished Professor, Hydrology and Water Resources","title_zh":"二级研究员，水文与水资源","bio_en":["Dr. Yongqiang Zhang is a Distinguished Professor in Hydrology and Water Resources at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences. He is a Non-European Fellow of the European Academy of Sciences (elected 2026) and also serves as the Deputy Director of the Key Laboratory of Land Water Cycle and Surface Processes. Professor Zhang is a Fellow of the Modelling and Simulation Society of Australia and New Zealand and a Fellow of the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation in Germany. He currently holds leadership roles as the Director of the Hydro-Geography Committee of the Geographical Society of China and chairs the Hydrometeorology Stream of the Modelling and Simulation Society of Australia and New Zealand. In addition, Professor Zhang serves on the editorial boards of five major international journals, including Journal of Geophysical Research: Atmospheres, Journal of Hydrology, and Remote Sensing of Environment. In the past five years alone, he has authored or co-authored 70 papers as first or corresponding author in top-tier journals. His research has been cited more than 24,000 times, and he has an H-index of 75. His most cited first-authored paper has accumulated over 700 citations. In addition, Professor Zhang has ten ESI Highly Cited Papers and has been recognized as an Elsevier Highly Cited Chinese Researcher for five consecutive years.","The team led by Professor Zhang comprises professors, associate professors, postdoc fellows, doctoral candidates, and master's students, totaling about 30 members. ## 研究者简介

马宁为中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所副研究员。他关注地表水文过程，结合观测、模型与遥感方法研究陆气水热交换及水循环对气候变化的响应。

## 研究方向

蒸散发过程与机理、陆面过程观测与模拟、生态水文和遥感水文。

## 相关研究

## 研究者简介

马宁为中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所副研究员。他关注地表水文过程，结合观测、模型与遥感方法研究陆气水热交换及水循环对气候变化的响应。

## 研究方向

蒸散发过程与机理、陆面过程观测与模拟、生态水文和遥感水文。
